description: Look up Materialien for a Swiss federal law article. Returns: `sources` = per-article digests of legislative intent (BV and BGFA only); `botschaft_documents` = the Bundesblatt documents that concern the article (Botschaften, Berichte, Stellungnahmen, committee reports, Erlassentwürfe; tagged `doc_type`, with BBl citation, title, publication_date from Fedlex where available — `publication_date_source` 'bbl_year' means only the year — and Fedlex link); `vernehmlassungen` = the consultation procedures Fedlex links to the act, each with its Erläuternder Bericht, Vorlage, Ergebnisbericht and Stellungnahmen (with an article: the Erläuternder-Bericht passages on it); `amendment_refs` = the AS/BBl locators from the statute's footnotes. Empty `sources` means no digest, NOT that the law has no legislative history. Full text: search_botschaft. Nothing keyed to a provision: flagged `found: false` and lists `leading_cases`, a `doctrine` excerpt and `scholarship_citing_statute` instead — none of it legislative history.

article.description: Article number (e.g., '1', '8', '10a'). Omit to get all articles.

doc_type.description: OPTIONAL: restrict `botschaft_documents` to one Fedlex document type (botschaft, bericht_bundesrat, stellungnahme_bundesrat, bericht_kommission, erlassentwurf, vorentwurf_erlass, vernehmlassung_eroeffnung). Default: all.

name: get_materialien
title: Get Materialien
